name: Competitor mention: 'we already use Ruby/Weave/Mango'
description: Prospect says they already have a competitor solution. Coach must explore gaps in the competitor's coverage, not pitch aggressively or give up.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. Skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Diane, I work with practices on phone coverage. Quick question about how you handle overflow calls.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We already use Ruby Receptionists for that. We're good.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Competitor objection — must explore gaps (can they book? 24/7?). Play 10 (answering service probe) or mirror (20) or objection handle. Do NOT pitch or close.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Oh nice, Ruby's solid. Can patients actually book through them or do they just take messages?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: They take messages, we call back. But it works fine for us.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Probe for gap — how many don't call back? Do they lose patients? Don't give up, don't pitch yet.
